notes: v0.6.9: ship pavucontrol scripts at the correct path + lxterminal as an image-overlay package. Three issues were discovered during the 2026-09-08 v0.6.8 g90digi deploy: (1) the pavucontrol scripts from v0.6.6 were committed only at g90-image/scripts/ but the launcher's run_script() reads from the top-level scripts/ dir on the deployed box, so the scripts never landed at /home/pi/shared_launcher/scripts/ on g90digi. (2) the top-level scripts/start_pavucontrol.sh path was gitignored (it was originally excluded because Slate had a parallel desktop-launcher-kit version with the same name). v0.6.9 un-excludes that path with an explanatory comment, and commits the g90 project versions there. (3) start_modem73_tui.sh on g90digi failed silently because lxterminal is not on the ReticulumHF base image (same trap as xterm in 2026-08). Fix: apt install lxterminal on g90digi now, add lxterminal to g90-image/IMAGE-PACKAGES.md so future image bakes include it. Verified on g90digi: Modem73 Config TUI Start opens lxterminal --title=modem73 with modem73 TUI; Stop pkill works; pavucontrol scripts land at /home/pi/shared_launcher/scripts/ after pull. Cumulative on top of v0.6.5 -> v0.6.8 + this fix.
